    base_vat/models/res_partner.py:111          -> account_vat/models/res_partner.py:112

    survey/models/survey_user_input.py:1544     -> survey/models/survey_user_input_line.py:80
      compute=_compute_answer_score, misleading

Net zero from those six. The remaining four departures are real, and each one is
the hook's target ceasing to exist where the field pointed:

    base_account/models/account_account.py:144   compute=_compute_account_tags   misnamed
    sale_purchase/models/sale_order_line.py:20   compute=_compute_purchase_count misnamed
    stock_account/models/stock_move.py:66        search=search_remaining_qty     misnamed

_compute_account_tags and search_remaining_qty are defined nowhere in the tree

although the method is still there.

Against those four, three arrivals that are not any of the above moved:

    maintenance/models/maintenance.py:192        default=_get_default_team_id    misnamed
    project/models/project_project.py:269        compute=_compute_task_count     misleading
